description: This script extracts embedded 'trash' directories from logs, decodes base64 encoded data, and unpacks tarballs. It includes functions for error handling and processing log lines to locate specific directory markers.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits with status 1.

methods.name: find_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines from input, searches for a specific start marker indicating the beginning of a trash directory, and sets the test_name variable.

methods.name: extract_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines from input, extracts the content between start and end markers, and handles unexpected input errors.
